sentences.span: Yesterday President Trump confirmed that he rejected Iran's proposal for a 7 day ceasefire
sentences.why: The rejection is real, but per this source (dated Sun 27 Sep, 'yesterday' = Saturday) and 17989 ('On Friday after the close, Trump announced that he had rejected Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz'), it happened Fri/Sat, not 'this morning.' No source in the pool is dated after Sun 27 Sep 3:51pm ET, so nothing supports a fresh, repeat ('again') Monday-morning rejection.

sentences.span: Strait of Hormuz flows are hovering at ~13-14 million barrels a day (7-day average). That's about the same as the brief peak in July
sentences.why: 13-14m/day is ~65% of the 21.2m/day 2025 normal cited in 17740, not 'roughly a quarter.' The ~quarter figure (4.9m/21.2m) is 17740's Q2 low, not the current level implied by the sentence's present tense 'sit at.'

sentences.span: After hitting an intra-day high of $108.16/bbl Brent crude did see a mostly temporary drop of around $4
sentences.why: Sources (this file and 17866: 'rose to as high as USD 108... but has since fallen by around USD 2') show $108 was a brief intraday touch followed by a pullback, not a level Brent is 'holding above.'

sentences.span: NO DEAL WITH ESCALATION – a return to $100/bbl oil and the 10Y yield above 5%
sentences.why: The JPM scenario framework and figures are real, but no source anywhere mentions a Saudi foreign minister meeting Rubio in Washington, and the Trump rejection is dated Fri/Sat (17989/17998), not 'this morning.'

sentences.span: Watch the 5.2% area first. Beyond that, the next major level is 5.5%
sentences.why: The 5.2%/5.5% levels are real, and 17896 confirms the 10yr 'rose to a post-2007 high of 5.20%' — but that happened midweek (Wed/Thu Sep 23-25), not 'this morning' of the pulse date; nothing in the pool confirms a same-day move.

sentences.span: ABB expects 25-40% of new datacenter additions in 2030 to be based on Direct Current
sentences.why: The 25-40% DC figure is ABB's; the $50bn battery-backup market figure is a separate Goldman note on Panasonic ('Batteries - Framing the battery backup unit opportunity, $50bn by 2030'). The sentence merges two different companies/theses into one causal 'its fix... opens' narrative.

sentences.span: investors are likely to scrutinise whether outsized capital expenditure is translating into sustainable return on equity
sentences.why: This ROE-skepticism argument belongs to Eastspring, not Jefferies. Jefferies' actual documented AI skepticism in the pool (17989) is about physical data-center buildout capacity via satellite tracking, a different critique.
